actions.description: Reset the served axis with the upstream reset (OR, WS0) and report whether the controller returns no error afterwards
actions.name: reset_axis

outputs.description: True once the reset was sent and TE? returned 0
outputs.name: reset

adjusts.description: Absolute target position for the served axis (PA), in the controller's own position units
adjusts.name: target_position

facts.text: The clone is a simple Python module to control a Newport ESP 301 stepper motion controller
The clone requires a USB or serial connection to the ESP301 and the PySerial module
The constructor takes dev, b, axis, reset, initpos and useaxis and opens serial.Serial(dev, b)
The served axes are useaxis, or axis alone when useaxis is empty; axis is kept as defaxis
When reset is true the constructor resets each axis in use and calls check_errors, and for a nonzero initpos it calls setpos
reset(axis) writes '<axis>OR;<axis>WS0' followed by a carriage return
check_errors writes 'TE?' followed by a carriage return and returns the reply as a float
getpos(axis) writes '<axis>TP' followed by a carriage return and returns the reply as a float
setpos(pos, axis) writes '<axis>PA<pos with four decimals>;<axis>WS1;<axis>TP' followed by a carriage return and returns the reply as a float
position(pos) with a numeric pos calls setpos, getpos and setpos again, and finally returns getpos
The clone defines no stop, abort or halt method: its methods are reset, check_errors, getpos, setpos and position
The clone reads and writes positions as bare floats and names no physical unit
The README usage example opens a device at 19200 baud with default axis 1 and calls setpos(20.0, 1); neither number is a travel range

measures.description: Position of the served axis as the controller reports it (TP), in the controller's own position units
measures.name: position

measures.description: Controller error number returned by TE? (0 means no error, as the constructor's check does)
measures.name: last_error

operator_required.name: target_position
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states the travel range of the axis: the constructor only defaults initpos to 0.0 (esp.py:4), the README's 20.0 is a usage example (README.md:13), and setpos hands any float to the controller (esp.py:36-42); the attached stage is configuration data, so the site supplies the envelope

safe_state.description: the served axis is re-initialized with the upstream reset ('<axis>OR;<axis>WS0') and the driver sends no new motion command; the clone has no separate motion-stop command
